# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Iteration cand_0005. Parent = champion cand_0001 (val 0.634). Capability = the spreadsheet
agent's system prompt (`prompt.md`); reader = azure/gpt-5.5. Only `prompt.md` is editable.

## Outcome of this iteration: NO SAFE EDIT FOUND — champion prompt preserved unchanged, diagnosis handed back.
Three fresh, independent diagnoses of THIS iteration's `./trajectories/` (3 parallel read-only
subagents) plus the objective LEDGER results of the last 3 rejected iterations converge on one
conclusion: **the prompt has reached its ceiling on this benchmark.** Every candidate edit fails
at least one of the THREE TESTS, so I ship none and preserve cand_0001.

## Method
- 3 parallel read-only subagents diagnosed, respectively: (A) the 5 recurring fragile passers,
  (B) the 10 always-failing tasks, (C) the 8 flaky tasks. Each loaded the trace JSON (instruction,
  answer_position, final code, feedback) and classified root cause.
- Read the champion `prompt.md` and all 4 prior `prior_iterations/*/diff.patch` + LEDGER + JOURNAL.

## Ranked clusters (this iteration's traces) and why each is NOT safely prose-fixable
| rank | cluster | tasks | root cause | tag | verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Per-task LOGIC errors | 269-44, 157-4, 398-14, 413-15, 577-40, 18137, 39946 (always-fail) + 30930, 49237, 50526, 53062, 53957, 139-16, 585-41 (flaky) | each a distinct wrong sign / grouping / boundary / parse / lookup tie-break / layout, unique to the task | LOGIC | Only a per-task worked example fixes each → overfits, fails held-out gate. SKIP. |
| 2 | answer_position vs instruction contradiction | 254-34 (single cell C2 expects a subset-sum value while instruction is about highlighting many cells) | grader target contradicts the literal instruction | DATA/CONTRACT | cand_0004 tried exactly this ("write value even when formatting asked") → broke 267-18,347-49,430-43,47699,58484. REFUTED. |
| 3 | Output-order ambiguity | 146-49, 413-15 | correct values, unknowable row/col order | AMBIGUITY | order is task-specific and unstated → cannot write a general rule. SKIP. |
| — | ENVIRONMENT / clock fault | 34-5 (and likely 32023) | "earlier than the current month" uses runtime `date.today()`=2026-08, but expected values were fixed at authoring time; code byte-matches on the value logic yet scores 0 on the date window | ENV | NOT a prompt defect. Handed back. |

## Why no additive behavioral rule is SAFE (the binding constraint)
The recurring fragile passer set **{267-18, 347-49, 430-43, 47699, 58484}** has been regressed by
EVERY added-prose iteration (cand_0002/0003/0004 broke sets all draw from it). Subagent A's
protection map explains why they are structurally hostile to the obvious levers:
- "always write a computed value even when formatting was asked" — breaks 267-18 (writes a URL
  *string* via prefix), 347-49 (pure row deletion + style copy, no scalar value), 430-43 (row
  hiding / autofilter, no cell value), 58484 (deliberately leaves most target cells blank, filling
  only the last row of each run — the exact thing the user asked for).
- "read full extent / locate columns by header" — breaks 47699 (headerless, marker-driven by a
  literal FALSE) and risks 347-49 (positional detail-row heuristic).
- "coerce text→number / write numeric answers as numbers" — breaks 267-18 (URL strings must stay
  text) — already REFUTED in cand_0002.
No discriminating condition includes the failing case 254-34 (single-cell answer, no headers) while
excluding 267-18/347-49/430-43/47699 — so a NARROWING rule cannot be constructed either.

## THREE TESTS applied to every candidate lever → all fail
- Additive behavioral rule (write-value-on-format / read-scope / coerce): fails **SAFE** (proven 3×
  to regress the fragile set; likely partly single-trial sampling noise, which the gate's
  significance bar is designed to reject).
- Per-task logic fix (e.g. 398-14 RET−SALE sign): fails **REAL/GENERALIZE** (special-cases one task;
  overfits, held-out gate rejects; also risks a same-family passer).
- Checklist shortening / consolidation (the only "low-risk direction" per subagent A): fails
  **VERIFIED** — it fixes no failing task (failures are logic, not checklist adherence) and rewrites
  text read on every task (unbounded, could perturb the same fragile passers). No demonstrable gain.

## Blast-radius statement
No prompt bytes changed → zero blast radius; all 51 passers preserved by construction. The candidate
is behaviorally identical to champion cand_0001.

## Environment fault handed back (HUMAN ACTION required — do NOT prompt-patch)
- **34-5** (and likely **32023**): clock-relative "current month / current department as of today".
  The grading sandbox clock (2026-08) falls outside the surviving-date window the answer was authored
  against; the agent cannot know the intended date. FIX: pin the sandbox clock to the authoring date,
  or exclude time-relative tasks from scoring. A prose workaround here would be a speculative edit
  against a broken environment and fails the REAL test.

## Deliberately skipped and why
- All per-task logic clusters (§1) — no safe general prose; each needs a task-specific worked example
  that overfits and fails the held-out gate.
- 254-34 answer_position contradiction (§2) — the only rule that fixes it is the one cand_0004 already
  proved regresses 5 passers. REFUTED; not re-tried.
- Output-order ambiguity (§3) — order unstated and task-specific.
- Consolidation/shortening — unverifiable benefit, unbounded risk to fragile passers.

## Process & features used
- 3 parallel read-only general-purpose subagents (one per trace group). No worktrees needed (no edit).
- Built on LEDGER facts: did NOT re-try type-coercion (cand_0002 breaker), read-scope+#N/A+deletion-fill
  (cand_0003 breaker), or write-value-on-format (cand_0004 breaker).
